name: Observation-operator geometry and instrument-coordinate verification
purpose: Verify LOS/tangent/spacecraft transforms and instrument coordinate conventions before comparing observations.
production_capability: Kaguya/LADEE/LAMP/LACE/PACE and ground-based sodium-tail observation geometry and operators.
configuration: One fixed, metadata-backed geometry case per instrument; SPICE kernels and aberration convention explicit. The Moon input receipt selects solid-angle shell weighting, projected-Sun limb branches, J2000 RA/Dec or ECLIPJ2000 lon/lat tail storage, display orientation, exposure duration, and an explicit beam-response status.
inputs: native observation epochs and exposure durations
independent_reference: SPICE round trips, analytical tangent geometry, and archive geometry fields.
units: UTC/ET, m, radians/degrees as explicitly converted
frame_time_convention: J2000, instrument, MOON_ME_DE421, and LSO transforms named with aberration correction.
procedure: Check normalized boresights, transform round trips, tangent points/altitudes, occultations, projected-Sun limb branch classification, solid-angle shell quadrature, bin/FOV footprints, finite-exposure/beam convolution, and serialized geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Norm/rotation error <=1e-13; physical position/tangent tolerance must be frozen from source geometry precision.
expected_pass_result: Each operator reproduces its independent geometry before science values are scored.
data_hashes: not evaluated because no single instrument case has both a complete production operator and complete authoritative geometry/response metadata
status_semantics: SKIPPED until a production operator, kernels, and authoritative geometry case are selected.
skip_reason: Kaguya uses embedded legacy tables without authoritative TVIS frame/FOV metadata; other requested production operators are absent. D14 is PARTIAL: it provides four brightest-beam coordinates, a circular diameter, and exposure duration, but no numerical full raster, per-beam timestamps, spectra, or radial WHAM response.
missing_capability: Qualified per-instrument geometry adapters using production operators, including solid-angle shell integration and finite-exposure/aperture convolution with authoritative response metadata.
